manualReview.scope: Model/editor Quality v3 remediation review of EN-A1-L-0107; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: This point is the cafe is controlled map language; Yes, that point is a natural confirmation.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian copy consistently uses «نقطه» and stays with a literal map-point sense.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: Dialogue-dependent tasks are ordered after exposure, duplicate exact-sentence assessment is practice-only, and hidden-answer retrieval remains the strongest evidence.

distractorQuality.evidence: This place is the cafe is a close same-domain contrast without the target word.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Generic story metadata was replaced where needed by scene copy grounded in the canonical setting and turns.

difficultyFit.evidence: The learner utterances are short and concrete.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Repeated exact target sentences may remain for practice, but only the strongest occurrence is scored; this reduces false mastery from repeated identical answers.

transferQuality.evidence: The second exchange moves from identifying the mapped location to confirming the indicated point.

overallCoherence.evidence: Map scenario, target sense and activities are aligned.

learnerExperience.evidence: Runtime ordering and answer tolerance were improved, but no real learner test is claimed.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
